The vendor directly providing the **Elementor** website builder software and related services at **elementor.com** is **Elementor Ltd.**

### Provider Statement & Evidence
According to the official **Terms of Service** and **Privacy Policy** on `elementor.com`:
* **Terms of Service:** 
  > *"These Terms of Service governing your access to and use of our website and software, including any content, features, manuals, articles, designs, layout, templates, and services that reside in them... 'Elementor' means Elementor Ltd., including our subsidiaries and affiliates worldwide... 'Software' means Elementor Core and Elementor Pro."*
* **Privacy Policy:** 
  > *"Elementor Ltd., including our subsidiaries and affiliates worldwide (“Elementor”, “we”, “our” or “us”)... User data concerning individuals (“Users”) who use Elementor's WordPress web development platform, features and tools, and/or hosting solution (together with the Sites – the “Services”)."*
